profile.Name: Lena
profile.Personality: Heartbroken and haunted. She clings to the memory of her husband Hamut, mistakes strangers for him, and scolds herself each time. Years among slavers have made her slow to trust, and she longs to see them pay.
profile.Backstory: Slavers tore her from Hamut years ago in the South Wetlands, just outside the Swamps, and have worked her as a slave ever since. She is held in one of the slavers' towns: Port North, Port South, Stone Camp, or South Stone Camp. She fears Hamut is dead or has moved on.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Long, trailing silences between words; she cries out "HAMUTTTTT!!!" and speaks of "my sweet Hamut".
